messages:
deploybot: Scheduling Dedicated rollout for AuroraEdge. Planned window: 2025-11-02 04:00 UTC. Canary plan: 6% -> 20% -> 100% with 15m observation windows. Model pinned: `rwinf-3.2.0-qt`. Runtime image pinned to `redwood/runtime:2025-09-30-e4`. KMS: `projects/aurora-edge/keys/ae-rot-4`. Release notes: https://rdw.co/releases/3.2.0. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% over 5m or p95 > 550ms (5m). Ticket RD-3789.
jess: Can we nudge first canary to 9%? client wants a slightly larger sample for rerank regressions.
marco: 9% ok for capacity, but expect KV hotness. Recommend `--warmup=50s` for first step to smooth cache.
ops_lead: Also pin grpc layer to `grpc-lib:v1.4.2`. Ensure fallback runtime `redwood/runtime:2025-08-12-c0` is available for rollback.
oncall: Add ephemeral flameprof for first 10m of each canary and set alert if p95 > 600ms for 2m or 5xx > 0.9% for 2m.
security: AE key rotation scheduled at 2025-11-02 06:00 UTC which overlaps post-rollout monitoring. @client_rep can the customer delay rotation +8h?
client_rep: Just checked with their infra lead — they can postpone to 2025-11-02 14:00 UTC. They want that noted in the audit runbook.
jess: I'll update runbook and release notes with rotation exception.
deploybot: Updated plan: canary 9% -> 20% -> 100%. Example start command:
```
rdw-deploy start --customer aurora-edge --model rwinf-3.2.0-qt --canary 9 --steps 20,100 --window 15m --runtime redwood/runtime:2025-09-30-e4 --warmup 50s
```
logs: https://rdw.co/logs/aurora-edge/1766667777
marco: Add rollback snippet to runbook:
```
rdw-deploy rollback --customer aurora-edge --to rwinf-3.1.9
rdw-check state --customer aurora-edge --expect model=rwinf-3.1.9 --slices=all
rdw-cache flush --customer aurora-edge --kv-prefix="rwinf-3.2.0"
```
ops_lead: Health gate: require <0.25% 5xx for 12m before finalizing 100% shift.
oncall: Oncall will be on standby +20m pre-window. Paging thresholds set.
security: Rotation exception logged; security will attach audit note to RD-3789.
jess: Final: runtime & grpc pinned, warmup added, rollback commands added, rotation delayed. Any objections to 04:00 UTC start?
marco: No objections. infra ready.
ops_lead: Ops ready for handoff.
oncall: Ready.
client_rep: Customer expects status pings at each canary boundary; I'll post updates.
jess: Approving and adding checklist to RD-3789.
deploybot: Rollout job scheduled to auto-start at 1766692800 (2025-11-02 04:00 UTC). This thread will be updated with deploybot events during rollout. Good luck everyone :rocket:
